headline: SEC Issues Exemptive Relief from Treasury Clearing Rules for Certain Repos
summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission issued exemptive relief related to inter-affiliate and non-U.S. repo transactions to assist market participants with central clearing requirements for U.S. Treasuries.
why: SEC regulatory adjustments for central clearing mandates impact compliance costs and operational workflows for broker-dealers and global repo market participants.

impacts.name: Broker-Dealers
impacts.why: Exemptive relief lowers regulatory burdens and compliance costs for broker-dealers participating in repo markets.
